title: WordPress on Hostinger: which plan to pick and how to start
seoTitle: WordPress on Hostinger: which plan and how to start
description: Which WordPress plan from Hostinger to pick for one site, three sites, several sites or a store, and how to start. US dollar prices from October 30, 2026, with renewal.
metaDescription: WordPress on Hostinger: Premium, Unlimited or Cloud Startup? Plan by project, price and renewal on October 30, 2026, and a checklist to start.
imageAlt: Hostinger logo with website and server icons, and the word WordPress on the band

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: If you have already decided to use WordPress on Hostinger, Premium covers up to three sites, Unlimited serves several sites or a store with daily backups, and Cloud Startup is for heavy traffic. The number of sites, the backup and the renewal price decide. SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period of a new purchase; renewals and domains are excluded.

contentSections.heading: Which plan for which project
paragraphs: Hostinger does not sell a WordPress-only plan: its WordPress hosting pages list plans by number of sites, space and backup. So the question is not "which plan has WordPress", but "how many sites will I have, and how much backup do I need?".

image.alt: WordPress on Hostinger chart by project: up to three sites go to Premium; several sites or a WooCommerce store go to Unlimited; a store or a site with heavy traffic goes to Cloud Startup
image.caption: The summary of the choice: the number of sites, the space and the backup decide the plan. Chart by Em Casa com Cecília, from what Hostinger's pages say.

bullets: **Up to 3 sites: Premium.** Your blog and two more projects, or a test site next to the main one. It has 20 GB SSD and weekly backups.
**Several sites or a store with WooCommerce: Unlimited.** Unlimited sites, 50 GB NVMe and daily backups. In a store, orders and stock change every day, and a weekly backup leaves a whole week out.
**A store or a site with heavy traffic: Cloud Startup.** Unlimited sites and 100 GB NVMe. It is the most expensive plan on the page, and its renewal is the highest too.
postParagraphs: When in doubt between two plans, look at the backup. If you will not change the site every week, weekly backups are enough; if you sell or publish every day, you want daily backups. Premium can buy daily backups as an extra; compare that cost with the upgrade to Unlimited.

contentSections.heading: Price and renewal
paragraphs: The prices below come from Hostinger's international site, in US dollars, as of October 30, 2026, on the 48-month term and the campaign's promotional price. The monthly price is the total divided by 48. Renewal is the monthly price after the first period. Prices can vary by country and currency, so check the cart:
postParagraphs: The page gives no end date for the campaign, and prices can change.
contentSections.emphasis: Compare the total commitment, equivalent monthly cost and renewal. Neither entry price nor renewal alone chooses a plan.

contentSections.heading: What comes with the plans
paragraphs: From Hostinger's international page, on October 30, 2026:
bullets: **Sites and space.** Premium: 3 sites and 20 GB SSD. Unlimited: unlimited sites and 50 GB NVMe. Cloud Startup: unlimited sites and 100 GB NVMe.
**Backups.** Premium has weekly backups and Unlimited has daily ones. The page does not say which backup Cloud Startup has, so check it in the cart.
**Domain and e-mail.** They change by plan and by period. Check in the cart what comes free and for how long.

contentSections.heading: How to start: the checklist
bullets: **1. List the requirements.** Count sites and check storage, application, expected workload and recovery needs before choosing.
**2. Sort out the domain.** Check whether your plan includes one, or point a domain you already have. Note when it renews.
**3. Install WordPress from the hosting panel.** You do not need to download the files by hand.
**4. Choose the theme before the content.** Switching themes on a full site means rework. Prefer a simple theme that is updated often.
**5. Install few plugins.** Start with what the site needs today: a contact form, SEO and, in a store, WooCommerce. Each extra plugin is one more thing to update.

**6. Make a backup before changing anything.** Before changing the theme, updating a plugin or changing the store, check the panel for the date of the last backup. With weekly backups, this matters more.
postParagraphs: How Hostinger charges, renews and refunds is covered in [Is Hostinger legit?](/en/reviews/is-hostinger-legit).

contentSections.heading: If you do not want WordPress
paragraphs: If you want less theme and plugin maintenance, compare the AI Builder with WordPress. Choose by required functions, integrations and site maintenance; knowing a plugin name does not decide it. contentSections.heading: Which plan to pick: the verdict
paragraphs: **Pick Premium** if you have one, two or three sites and publish now and then. It is the cheapest entry and renewal on the page, at US$ 10.99 a month when it renews.
**Pick Unlimited** if you have a store or many sites. The daily backup is the main reason, and it starts here.
**Cloud Startup** only makes sense if Unlimited is not enough. It is the most expensive, and the renewal of US$ 25.99 a month weighs on the budget.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Which is the cheapest WordPress plan on Hostinger? Premium, at US$ 2.49 a month over 48 months (US$ 119.52 in total), for up to 3 sites. It renews at US$ 10.99 a month.
Does WordPress come installed on Hostinger? You install it from the hosting panel, without downloading files by hand. The checklist above covers the steps.
Which WordPress plan suits an online store? Unlimited, for its daily backups and unlimited sites. For a store with heavy traffic, Cloud Startup.
Does the SONAR20 code work on the WordPress plans? SONAR20: 20% off the first period of an eligible new purchase. Check your WordPress plan at checkout; domain registration and renewal are excluded.
Is the renewal price the same as the promotional price? No. After the first 48-month period, the renewal price applies: for Premium, US$ 10.99 a month.

Can existing customers use SONAR20? It can apply to an eligible new purchase with the same account, not renewal of the current service. Domain registration is also excluded. Enter the code and check the cart total.

takeIf: Take Premium if it is one site only and you publish now and then: it is the entry plan.
Take Premium too if you will have two or three sites.
Take Unlimited if you have a store or many sites: the daily backup starts there.
skipIf: Skip Cloud Startup if Unlimited is still enough: it is the most expensive plan, on renewal too.
Compare another tool if you do not want to manage themes and plugins; check functions, integrations and costs before replacing WordPress with the AI Builder.
